title: Desert Locust - Everything You Need to Know About FAO’s 2019-2021 Crisis Response
location: Greater Horn of Africa · Rome HQ
shortDescription: Produced and edited utilizing field footage gathered throughout the 2019-2021 Desert Locust upsurge to brief international donors on how rapid intervention protected 41.5 million people from food insecurity.
mandateChallenge: Synthesize two years of emergency biopesticide aerial operations, satellite telemetry, and field campaigns across East Africa and Southwest Asia into a high-impact multilingual donor briefing film.
executionCraft: Coordinated, scripted, edited, and animated custom telemetry overlays and bold kinetic impact counters in English, French, and Arabic.
impactMetric: 41.5M People Protected · Produced in EN / FR / AR
